title: Reading Drill — Finding Space for Outdoor Exhibits
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Finding Space for Outdoor Exhibits
passages.body:
**A** A sculpture group considered three public sites for outdoor exhibits. It measured how much space would remain for pedestrians once each piece had a protective base.

**B** The group ruled out a narrow site even though it had high foot traffic. That site had no room for a person to stop and read a caption without interrupting others.

**C** It then put lightweight copies at two sites. Notes on how long people stopped helped the team choose a final location within the larger square.

questions.prompt: It measured how much space would remain for pedestrians once each piece had a protective ______.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: It measured how much space would remain for pedestrians once each piece had a protective base.

questions.prompt: That site had no room for a person to stop and read a ______ without interrupting others.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: That site had no room for a person to stop and read a caption without interrupting others.

questions.prompt: Notes on how long people stopped helped the team choose a final location within the ______.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: Notes on how long people stopped helped the team choose a final location within the larger square.

questions.prompt: The site with high foot traffic was chosen simply because it was busy.
questions.instructions: Does this statement agree with the information in the passage?
questions.explanation: The group ruled out a narrow site even though it had high foot traffic. That site had no room for a person to stop and read a caption without interrupting others.

questions.explanation: It then put lightweight copies at two sites. Notes on how long people stopped helped the team choose a final location within the larger square.
